notes.title: IRON WORLD is now available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

IRON WORLD is out, and we’d like to thank everyone who has supported us throughout its development. The game is evolving, and we plan on making it much further, together.

notes.title: Pre-Early access Hotfix
notes.notes:
Special thanks to the [b]Splattercatgaming[/b] channel and viewers who left feedback in comments. 

[b]Fixes[/b]

1. We have removed camera height change. Now the camera height is fixed and higher than before.
2. You can't shoot in View mode, but you can throw grenades.
3. Fixed appearance of a message about clearing locations.
4. Enemies get closer to player faster and shoot more often.
5. Fixed speed of camera on global map.
6. New starting location "Camp in rocks".
7. A number of minor fixes.

notes.title: 3 Days Until Release + Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Just 3 days left until IRON WORLD is available in Early Access. And today we’d like to tell you about the current state of the game and our plans for its future.

Early Access is the first step in a long journey that we’ll have to cover with your support. There is a lot of content and mechanics to be added, and the pace of the game’s advancement will largely be influenced by your interest. 

First off – the current state of things. As of now, the core gameplay is pretty much complete. Combat, car and crafting mechanics, travel, hunger & thirst, and character advancement are all functional and available in EA.

The current build includes:

The current version includes:

- The Prologue of main story
- 3 enemy types: raiders, turrets and dogs
- 14 weapons
- 14 car modules
- 13 perks
- 6 car-mounted weapons
- 60+ items
- Crafting
- Global Map encounters
- Survival Mode
- Randomized loot
- Procedurally generated locations

The world is potentially boundless!

Next – the Roadmap. There is a lot to be added:

1) Expanding the world. First on the line is adding more of everything:
-New enemies
-New weapons
-New perks
-New locations
-Permadeath mode

2) Complex features:
-Enemies driving their own cars and Mad Max'esque top-down action!
-Character’s own settlement
-Minigames

3) Advanced features (available only with the game’s success):
-Complete main storyline
-Local co-op
-Gamepad support

notes.title: Devlog #1: GENERATION OF OBJECTS
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Now our team is working on improving the replayability and variety of environment. The following improvements are planned.

1. For same type of map, for example, a raider camp, some objects will be picked randomly from a preloaded list. Imagine that there are 3 important points on the map: A, B, C. The following buildings have been created for them: a hut, a destroyed house, a barrack, a warehouse, a workshop, etc. In place of A, B, C, any of these buildings may appear. The same location will look completely different with each walkthrough.

2. Objects inside houses: furniture, decor, loot will also be random. In place of the refrigerator  may appear an armchair, a wardrobe or a heap of garbage.

3. For almost  objects in the game there are several images with varying degrees of wear. Which in turn will also be selected randomly.

In total, this gives hundreds of possible combinations even for one location, and we have planned a wide list of various maps: farms, raider camps, towns, landfills, gas stations, residential area, highway eateries and much more. We want to create a whole world for you!

notes.title: Iron World is alive! Iron World is being developed!
Large Update #2
notes.notes:
Thanks to the feedback from the players, we have made a number of important improvements.

[list]
[*] The tutorial has been completely redesigned. Now this is a separate mini-prologue in which you will get acquainted with Dante's talking eggplant))
[*] Various UI improvements: large item icons, larger and more noticeable enemy health bars, more convenient indicators of reloading and grenade throwing.
[*] Minimap.
[*] Shaking the camera when taking damage.
[*] Increased viewing area.
[*] Faster characters and animations of melee weapon strikes.
[*] Removed the sliding effect.
[*] Slightly slowing down enemies from damage.
[*] More noticeable effects of hits for bullets.
[*] Using items from the ground.
[/list]
